<div class="card-body">
'''I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">なんだか嫌な予感がする</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：このターンに相手が4人以上のキャラクターを同じ位置に配備した場合に使用する。それらのキャラクターは全員、このターンの間は戦闘を行えない。2：相手が戦闘に対して“リアクション”を行った直後に使用する。その戦闘をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-I-Have-A-Very-Bad-Feeling-About-This-PSA-173318901.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「あの小型機、小さな月に向かってるよ」「月ではない。あれは宇宙ステーションだ」オビ＝ワンの言葉を聞いてルークは胸騒ぎを覚えた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' I have a somehow unpleasant premonition.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Use if the opponent deployed 4 or more characters to the same location this turn. Those characters may not battle for the rest of this turn.

2: Use immediately after the opponent “reacts” to a battle. Cancel that battle.

'''Lore:'''
“That small craft is heading for a small moon.” “That is not a moon. It is a space station.” Hearing Obi-Wan's words, Luke felt a pang of unease.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is なんだか嫌な予感がする. The Japanese numbers the two options.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
